summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (_0xNNNN identifier scheme) and at install time downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (rotate-shift string array via function WV8StW, large numeric/character dictionary, hex-mangled identifiers, '// @bun @bun-cjs' header) whose behavior is not observable from the source. The package advertises itself as a browser web-chat SDK, a purpose that does not require fetching a second language runtime or executing an opaque compiled payload during npm install. Using Bun rather than Node to run the payload also bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners and inspection tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
